text: Prioritize pruning, watering, and observation to make gardening rewarding. Prune first to sustain plant health and stimulate new growth. Strip away dead or diseased leaves so diseases and pests cannot spread. Water regularly, particularly when temperatures rise, ensuring the soil stays moist without becoming waterlogged. Watch the garden constantly for pest or disease indicators so problems can be fixed quickly. Proper care allows your plants to flourish. This approach yields fresh food and creates an attractive area for enjoyment.
